contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payments-payment-methods-payment-method-connect-support-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-payment-method-connect-support-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-payment-method-connect-support.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/payment-method-connect-support`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7 capture of https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/payment-method-connect-support is a full method-specific Connect reference. Capabilities depend on the method and the account collecting the payment. For direct bank transfer charges the connected account itself must have activated the bank transfer payment method. Unmet capability requirements can keep the capability inactive, and general account activation is a separate possible blocker (new raw lines 101-113). For recurring BLIK the platform and each relevant connected account request blik_payments before blik_recurring_payments and need both active for off-session PI or SetupIntent use (new raw lines 137-145). For SEPA destination charges on behalf of a connected account, the merchant of record needs a fresh customer mandate through a PI or SetupIntent naming that account; destination cloning is excluded (new raw lines 469-477). PayPal remains for online marketplaces and supports destination/separate charges but excludes direct/on_behalf_of; request, joint review and post-approval account linking are distinct (new raw lines 348-369). May had only base BLIK/SEPA capability instructions and shorter PayPal access notes (old raw lines 155-173, 364-374 and 474-476). source-stripe-payment-method-connect-support.md preserves much of the baseline but gives Alma only two charge types although both matrices list four.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/payment-method-connect-support, November substantively adds recurring BLIK capability sequencing, SEPA destination mandate scope, and PayPal access review, linking and connected-account configuration guidance (new raw lines 137-145, 348-369 and 469-477; old raw lines 155-173, 364-374 and 474-476). The ACH descriptor/settlement tables disappear from this page, but the May 8 provenance stays dated and November retains authorization, destination failure fee refund and constrained cloning (old raw lines 22-63; new raw lines 23-45). The title, punctuation, table formatting and management link are presentation or navigation, with PayNow's no-full-Dashboard MCC wording kept scoped. Correct source-stripe-payment-method-connect-support.md to retain Alma's four charge support columns under marketplace eligibility (old raw lines 107-117; new raw lines 89-99), and preserve Cash App platform-saved descriptor exceptions separately. Keep the reciprocal Payment Methods concept route, method-specific BLIK, SEPA, ACH and PayPal routes, and both captures. Both captures have 30 section headings, including combined Afterpay/Clearpay, so the source and reciprocal catalog prose should avoid a 31-method inventory claim (old raw lines 18-502 and new raw lines 19-503).
